questions.title: Common questions
questions.description: A few things to know before you get started.

items.question: What is Lab Lords?
items.answer: Lab Lords helps you manage students, seats, shifts, fees and branches. It is built for study libraries and study halls, with support for the daily records of coaching and tuition centres.

items.question: Can I try it before paying?
items.answer: Yes. Eligible new owners get a 30-day trial with Standard features. No card is needed. The trial starts after you set up your first branch.

items.question: Can I use my existing student list?
items.answer: Yes. Import your student records and review the details before adding them. You can also add students one at a time.

items.question: Can my staff use Lab Lords?
items.answer: Yes. Standard includes staff access. You choose the permissions each staff member needs.

items.question: Can I manage more than one branch?
items.answer: Yes. Both plans support multiple branches. Each billable branch has a separate monthly charge.

items.question: Does Lab Lords work on a phone?
items.answer: You can use Lab Lords in a web browser on your phone or computer. An internet connection is needed.

items.question: Where can I check the plans?
items.answer: Visit the Pricing page to compare Basic and Standard and see how branch charges work.
